The entire representation undergoes a slow, rhythmic vertical oscillation, simulating the natural rise and fall of the tides. A specific, darker horizontal band remains visible, acting as a persistent marker for the peak of the tidal cycle. The visualization maintains a perpetual, organic movement throughout, existing entirely independent of any user interaction.

A persistent dark band marks the peak of each tidal cycle, serving as a visual anchor for the viewer's perception of the water's natural rhythm. The visualization operates entirely autonomously, creating an immersive representation of ocean dynamics through carefully modulated color gradients and movement patterns that maintain visual interest without any user interaction.
